embeds.title: 🟡 VS Code Zero-Day Lets Hackers Steal GitHub Tokens in One Click
embeds.description:
Security researcher Ammar Askar disclosed a VS Code zero-day vulnerability that allows attackers to steal GitHub OAuth tokens by tricking users into clicking malicious links. The exploit abuses VS Code's sandboxed webview message-passing system to install malicious extensions that extract GitHub tokens with full repository access. Askar chose immediate public disclosure due to prior negative experiences with Microsoft's security response process. The vulnerability remains unpatched and has not been assigned a CVE ID.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Malicious link click
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** reported
